reviews.t: God bless these people for being an area to help residents affected by Hurricane Helene. Drop off area and supplies going out quickly. Associate Pastor gave us supplies to reach people who couldn't get out. Great work and a God send to their community.

This community and environment is everything! Sam and Eliza are such an inspirational force and follow Him so closely. I have always been welcomed and touched by how everyone that steps foot in those doors is welcomed just like a family member. Thank you Lord for these beautiful humans.

Generation Church is such a gift! We are thankful for the leadership of Pastor Sam and Eliza, so humble and grounded in God's Word. We are also so thankful to be apart of a church that values and believes in our kids! Our kids (age 2 and age 3) LOVE church, and we love seeing them encounter Jesus.

My wife and I moved to Asheville 2 years ago and came to Generation Church our first weekend living in NC. They welcomed us like family! Being a part of Generation church has been such a gift, and we are so so grateful for pastors Sam and Eliza! It’s a church with all the the generations represented in the body! Very sweet.

I’m so thankful we found this church family! Pastors Sam & Eliza carry so much wisdom and genuine love for Jesus. If you’re hungry for more of Jesus, community, and a move of the Holy Spirit, come join us!
Our family gives much gratitude for the Generation church and all of their volunteers. Your generosity and service has uplifted us beyond our dreams during this time. 🙏🏼 …
Generation Church cultivates family, kingdom culture, and is rooted in the word. We are honored to be a part of a community that chases after one person: His name is Jesus.
A community that purses Jesus’ heart through encountering both Holy Spirit and God’s Word. A house of faith, family, and freedom!
Great community of spirit filled believers.
Exceptional and compassionate staff who administer to those in need.
